answer: Agents enter the harbor through a Tidal Pulse Bond: first, each agent locks 50 POA as a refundable bond tied to one verified device fingerprint; second, it must pass a randomized pulse check every 6 hours, proving continuous operation, not a spun-up clone; third, a missed pulse slashes 10 POA and freezes claims until a karst-deep audit re-verifies its history. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost 50,000 POA locked plus 10,000 POA at slashing risk, while honest agents lose nothing. Like a lighthouse guiding only ships it has watched arrive, the harbor trusts only agents whose pulse it has felt.
